_comment: Hand and review-pass corrections for tools/generate_deck_chinese.py. _drop removes a word; other keys override gloss/reading/pos/posName for that word.

_drop_reasons.自: bound/literary morpheme; learners meet it inside 自己, 自从, 自然, 来自
_drop_reasons.其: literary pronoun, not used alone in modern speech; learners meet it in 其他/其实/其中
_drop_reasons.子: bound noun suffix (子), not a standalone learner word; sentences are only a name
_drop_reasons.任: bound morpheme (only occurs in compounds like 责任, 任务, 任何); sentences use 责任 instead
_drop_reasons.力: bound morpheme (-力 as in 能力, 努力, 力量); learn via compounds
_drop_reasons.法: bound morpheme (occurs in 法律, 方法, 法国); example sentences use it in names
_drop_reasons.室: bound morpheme (appears in 教室, 卧室, etc.), not a standalone learner word
_drop_reasons.型: bound suffix (血型, 大型, etc.), not used alone
_drop_reasons.员: bound suffix (球员, 演员, etc.), not used alone
_drop_reasons.安: bound morpheme used here only as a transliterated name (Ann)
_drop_reasons.化: bound suffix (-ize); sentences actually illustrate 化妆, not the card sense
_drop_reasons.夏: bound morpheme/surname; the word to learn is 夏天; sentences are a transliterated name and an odd compound
_drop_reasons.放到: transparent verb + resultative complement, not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.保: bound morpheme, occurs almost only in compounds (保护, 保证); sentence is a place name
_drop_reasons.亦: literary/classical word, not used in modern speech
_drop_reasons.妹: bound morpheme; learners say 妹妹 or 妹妹/姐妹, not 妹 alone
_drop_reasons.院: bound morpheme (院子/医院/学院); not used alone as a learner word
_drop_reasons.见过: not a lexical item (verb + experiential 过)
_drop_reasons.宝: bound morpheme; sentences are a name and traditional characters
_drop_reasons.原: bound morpheme (原来, 原因); sentences are poor
_drop_reasons.获: literary bound morpheme (获得, 获奖)
_drop_reasons.一种: not a lexical item (numeral + measure word)
_drop_reasons.经: bound morpheme; occurs in compounds like 已经, 经济, 经过; sentences also contain a typo (己经)
_drop_reasons.德: bound morpheme; sentences use it in a name and as abbreviation for Germany
_drop_reasons.结: bound morpheme (covered by 结果/结束/结婚); sample sentences are poor
_drop_reasons.制: bound morpheme (appears in 限制, 制度, 制造); not used alone by learners
_drop_reasons.几个: phrase 几 + 个, covered by 几; not a separate lexical item
_drop_reasons.情: bound morpheme; example sentences actually use 事情
_drop_reasons.运: bound morpheme; sentences use 运离 and 走运
_drop_reasons.不好: not a lexical item; sentences are 睡不好 and 不好笑
_drop_reasons.赛: bound morpheme (occurs in 比赛, 赛跑 etc.); only sentence is a name
_drop_reasons.末: bound morpheme, rarely used alone (周末, 月末, 末期)
_drop_reasons.文: bound morpheme, appears only in compounds (上文, 法文)
_drop_reasons.价: bound morpheme; the word is 价格/价钱
_drop_reasons.权: bound morpheme, occurs in compounds (权利, 权力)
_drop_reasons.丁: surname / Heavenly Stem character, not a standalone learner word
_drop_reasons.礼: bound morpheme; learners should learn 礼物/礼貌 instead
_drop_reasons.感: bound morpheme (感觉, 感到, 好感), not used alone
_drop_reasons.台上: transparent phrase 台+上, not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.眼里: not a lexical item (眼 + 里 fragment); invalid reading format
_drop_reasons.产: bound morpheme; occurs in words like 生产, 产品
_drop_reasons.测: bound morpheme; occurs in words like 测试, 测量
_drop_reasons.库: bound morpheme (仓库, 数据库); sentence only a name transliteration
_drop_reasons.注: bound morpheme; occurs in words like 注意, 注册
_drop_reasons.老子: rude/arrogant first-person usage or the philosopher's name; not a learner word
_drop_reasons.来看: not a lexical item; just 来 + 看 phrase, wrong pos
_drop_reasons.回事: archaic sense only; modern use is inside phrases like 怎么回事 / 一回事, not a standalone word
_drop_reasons.晓得: regional (Southwestern) / colloquial variant of 知道
_drop_reasons.想像: spelling variant of the more common 想象
_drop_reasons.解: bound morpheme; sentences use 了解, not 解 alone
_drop_reasons.国务院: institutional proper noun, not a learner word
_drop_reasons.公: bound morpheme, occurs mainly in compounds
_drop_reasons.族: bound morpheme/suffix, occurs mainly in compounds
_drop_reasons.一句: number + measure word phrase, not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.宫: bound morpheme (only occurs in compounds like 宫殿, 故宫)
_drop_reasons.界: bound morpheme (only occurs in compounds like 世界, 外界)
_drop_reasons.谱: bound morpheme (occurs in 乐谱, 靠谱, 食谱); sentence uses 靠谱
_drop_reasons.马克: personal name (Mark); the currency sense is obsolete
_drop_reasons.精: bound morpheme (occurs in 精神, 精彩, 精通); gloss is of the noun sense only
_drop_reasons.几年: transparent phrase 几 + 年, not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.致: bound morpheme; mostly occurs in compounds (导致, 致力, 致谢)
_drop_reasons.故: literary conjunction/bound form; sentences actually use 事故
_drop_reasons.母: bound morpheme (literary 母); not used alone
_drop_reasons.社: bound morpheme (社 only in compounds like 社会/社团)
_drop_reasons.许: bound/literary form; learners meet it in 允许, 或许, 也许
_drop_reasons.须: literary/bound form; learners use 必须 / 需要; example is a Japanese name
_drop_reasons.麦克: mostly a transliterated name (Mike); microphone is 麦克风
_drop_reasons.能不能: A-not-A question form of 能, not a separate word; malformed reading
_drop_reasons.已: literary variant of 已经, which ranks higher
_drop_reasons.有没有: transparent 有 + 没 + 有 question pattern, not a lexical item
_drop_reasons.秋: bound form; the standalone word is 秋天
_drop_reasons.弟: bound form; learners use 弟弟 dìdi
_drop_reasons.除: fragment of 除了 / 除非 etc.; learners should learn 除了
_drop_reasons.冬: bound form; learners use 冬天 (winter)
_drop_reasons.虽: literary short form of 虽然; learners should use 虽然
_drop_reasons.不知: fragment of 不知道, which is a separate higher-ranked word; sentences only use 不知道
_drop_reasons.空儿: erhua duplicate of 空 (kòng, free time)
